Driveways & block paving

Make an entrance.

Block paving and driveway enquiries in Northampton. Explore patterns, edging and practical groundwork, then request a free quotation.

A driveway that belongs to your home.

A driveway should feel considered from the road to the front door. Block size, colour, laying pattern and border details all help shape the result. NN Paving offers block paving and resin driveway services, with the groundwork planned around your space.

Block paving

Explore a traditional or contemporary look with complementary blocks and clearly defined borders. Talk through the pattern, parking layout and edges with Leon.

Resin driveways

Ask about resin driveway options for your property. Suitability, the existing base and the drainage design need to be assessed for the particular project.

What lies beneath

Levels, ground preparation, retaining features and drainage deserve attention before choosing the finish. NN Paving’s recent driveway post describes a substantial front build-up and retaining walls on both sides.

Planning your project

How much will my driveway or patio cost?

Every space is different. Size, materials, access, existing surfaces, drainage and the amount of groundwork all affect the cost. Ask for a quotation for your property rather than relying on a generic price per square metre.

How long does the work take?

Timing depends on project size, preparation, materials and weather. Discuss an estimated schedule and arrangements for access when requesting your quotation.

What guarantees and payment terms are offered?

Ask Leon to confirm any applicable workmanship or product guarantees, payment schedule and exclusions in writing with your quotation. Terms are project-specific; no fixed guarantee or finance plan is advertised on this website.
